fast_lane.finality: ProgramTest has no finalized commitment. `slot` is the bank slot observed at submission; it orders the campaign and is NOT proof of finality. A validator tier is still owed for every row here.
fast_lane.no_loader_v3_dependency: Satisfied for the checkpoint lifecycle. Create through cleanup read the Trading-owned checkpoint PDA, the request digest, a RentCredit and the System Program. None of them reads ProgramData, requires a SetAuthority(Some -> None), or inspects a deployment slot. The Trading ELF is added by ProgramTest at a fixed address and no checkpoint stage asks how it got there. NOT claimed for the Hot rows in this campaign: admitted-AOT authenticates a Loader V3 deployment pair for the accelerator, and this tier constructs those accounts rather than deploying them.
fast_lane.no_packet_limit_dependency: MEASURED, and the answer is mixed -- which is the point of measuring. Every legacy transaction serialises itself (one short-vector signature count byte, one 64-byte signature, the exact canonical message bytes) and records the extent. Six of the seven checkpoint stages fit with room: cleanup 276, evaluate 409, create 541, page 871, reserve 1,026, rollback 1,026 bytes against Solana's 1,232. COMMIT DOES NOT: the one commit submitted as a legacy transaction measures 1,366 bytes, which is exactly why every other commit travels as a v0 transaction over an Address Lookup Table -- and those record wire_bytes null, the emitter's word for 'did not measure', never a claim that the frame fits. THE HOT ROWS DO NOT FIT EITHER, at 2,342 to 3,084 bytes; they could not be submitted to a cluster as they stand, and that is why they are recorded with no route claim rather than credited to a route on a frame no validator would accept. All four facts are pinned by witnesses rather than asserted here.
fast_lane.compute_and_heap: Split, and stated rather than claimed. The checkpoint stages run at the ProgramTest default compute limit of 1,400,000 with the default 32,768-byte heap and request neither; no diagnostic budget is used anywhere. The Hot rows DO request a 65,536-byte heap frame (DIRECT_HOT_HEAP_FRAME_BYTES_V1), because the admitted route needs it on chain too, so those rows do not satisfy this clause and are not claimed under it.
fast_lane.real_account_shapes: Partially, and narrowly. The checkpoint stages touch the real System Program account and the Trading-owned checkpoint and RentCredit accounts, whose shapes the routes themselves authenticate. The campaign builds no Token-2022 mint with extensions and no upgradeable-loader account for the checkpoint rows. That is a narrower statement than 'the account shapes are real' and it is the one this tier can defend.
